profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Software Engineer with background in Mathematics, and history in the freight logistics industry. My experiences have taught me to be logical, practical, flexible, and delivery-driven in my approach.

positions.title: Hacker in Residence (Software Engineering Teaching Fellow)
positions.description:
-  Improved student growth by delivering instruction / mentorship on Javascript and web development fundamentals
    -  Contributed to teaching materials by creating projects for supplementary technical instruction
    -  Appraised coding / interpersonal skills of applicants through interviews, ensuring incoming student quality

positions.title: Pricing Coordinator
positions.description:
- Assisted in handling daily requests related to quotes, contracts, or costs with both vendors and clients
- Assisted in troubleshooting the implementation of/transition to a pricing system, along with assisting in maintenance of existing processes for pricing updates
- Assisted in organization/coordination of RFQ bidding processes

positions.title: Pricing Supervisor
positions.description:
- Designed, implemented, improved, and maintained tool for internal cost visibility
- Managed and maintained contracts with VOCC vendors; handled daily requests, filings, and issues
- Supported global clients as an inside sales window and internal coordinator for ad-hoc issues/inquiries/updates
- Supported sales teams by providing updated market information, and sourcing for customer demands to maintain competitiveness

projects.title: Colonies of Cotton
projects.description:
Online clone of the "Settlers of Catan" board game. Built using: React, Node/Express, MongoDB.

- Designed user interface using React and Semantic UI, providing intuitive gameplay experience
- Implemented turn based rule logic to deliver game’s core functionality using Socket.io and React
- Managed git workflow among team members, minimizing git conflicts and enhancing team’s productivity

projects.title: GP Scavenger
projects.description:
A location based multiplayer scavenger hunt app for Android, built in React Native. Node/Express back-end using ElephantSQL.

- Implemented authentication and login with Firebase, giving users persistent identity
- Designed editor, allowing users to create and edit custom game templates
- Created and maintained documentation throughout project, standardizing app appearance and structure
